requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The requirement mixes a functional action (inform security service) with a quality criterion (within 2 seconds). Per Pohl §25.2, it is decomposed into a functional requirement and a quality requirement.

source_fragments: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service.

fields.condition: the glass break detector detects the pane has been damaged

structured_requirements.final_statement: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service.
structuring_notes: Extracted functional action from concern-mixed requirement. Timing constraint moved to separate quality requirement.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The alarm notification shall be delivered to the security service within 2 seconds at the latest after damage detection.
structuring_notes: Extracted quality criterion (timing) as a separate artefact per Pohl §25.2.
